scores:
Lane: objective, judging both proposals against the files.

Contract-first: 8/10.
- Coverage proof (ownership table, per-section census, two-way page census, conformance pin) is mechanical and every load-bearing seam checks out. Verified citations: readRules walks document.styleSheets only (@orkestrel/test dist/src/browser/index.js:2291-2303); readCascade uses the regex /\.([a-zA-Z][\w-]*)/ (:2196); waitForAnimations skips infinite animations (:1351-1352); appJourney takes no override (vite.config.ts:380-402); sheetProject loads tests/setupBrowser.ts as a setup file (vite.config.ts:152); RECIPE_INPUT, compileRecipe, and readRecipe(path) sit at tests/setupServer.ts:945, 962-975, and 987-998; RecipeRecord sits at tests/setup.ts:1870-1880; the pin pattern sits at tests/conformance.test.ts:1343-1376; the integration test refuses interactive roles (tests/app/browser/integration.test.ts:10,35); the barrel asserts no exports (index.test.ts:5-7); variant naming follows SKILL.md:91-92; the inert refusal voice follows layer.md:162 and index.js:461-465.
- The Tailwind face proves co-use through readings. Each reading was checked against the cascade contract: px-8 beats a layered btn padding; rounded-pill's unlayered important beats rounded-full; grid beats card-body's display; the hidden-attribute departure appears at guides/veneer.md:435 and :441-443.
- Honest about the missing engine: no stand-in script; the specimens are inert static skins.
- Deductions: one false constraint, an engine table whose pin is wrong for its purpose, a duplicate contents name that breaks J3, a statechart missing its event union, and an unlisted collision on tests/setupBrowser.ts.

Experience-first: 4/10.
- The proposal text is truncated after its coverage paragraph, so its units, journeys, statechart, browse, and risks are NOT-EVIDENCED.
- Its face mechanism, swapping document.adoptedStyleSheets, hides both sheets from readCensus and readCascade (index.js:2293 reads document.styleSheets only). No census can then prove which classes the cascade declares under either face.
- It shows a Compositions group only in the Tailwind face, so the DOM differs between faces and a same-markup comparison between faces is impossible.
- What is worth grafting: the control-group names "Stylesheets" and "Color mode", and the visible face-swap mechanism.

Winner: contract-first. The synthesis grafts the runner-up's control naming and a side contents column built only from Bootstrap classes.

Verdict: contract-first wins with required changes; experience-first is UNRESOLVED beyond its truncated summary.
falseClaims: contract-first CONSTRAINTS: "package.json:146 pins tailwindcss 4.3.3; no @orkestrel/browser in package.json:130-153 before the scaffold visit". FALSE. package.json:132 declares "@orkestrel/browser": "^0.0.20", node_modules/@orkestrel/browser/dist/bin/main.js is installed, and the installed quality.md carries the browse rules. tailwindcss sits at package.json:147, and :146 is sass. Required change: U0 confirms the scaffold visit already present rather than waiting for it.

contract-first ENGINE and U1: ENGINE_MODULES "pinned to tests/fixtures/bootstrap/engine.json in both directions" per file, in a table column "Classes it writes". WRONG BASIS. engine.json records one witness site per name: 20 names and 20 sites. Grouping by file therefore gives popover.js no names (bs-popover-auto is cited at tooltip.js), modal.js only modal-static, and dropdown.js sole ownership of show. The fixture also lists no tab.js, scrollspy.js, or alert.js, all of which Bootstrap ships. A per-file pin makes the table state false writes. Required change: pin only the union of registry members that engine.json writes, in both directions. Author the per-module attribution as labelled prose, and add Tab, Scrollspy, and Alert rows.

contract-first SHOWCASE GROUPS: "Helpers: ... Position" and "Utilities: ... Position" give two contents links with the accessible name Position. J3's clickAccessibleWithin('Contents','link',SECTION_TITLE) then throws 'is ambiguous across 2 elements inside "Contents"' (index.js:538). Required change: make the titles unique, for example "Position helpers" and "Position utilities", and add a unique-title assertion to constants.test.ts.

contract-first TAILWIND reading "`hidden d-flex` reads none under Tailwind and flex under Bootstrap". This is true only for the hidden ATTRIBUTE with .d-flex (guides/veneer.md:435,441-443). Written as two classes, Tailwind's .hidden is a layered normal declaration and .d-flex is an unlayered !important, so both faces read flex. Required change: the specimen is <div hidden class="d-flex">, and the reading names the attribute.

contract-first STATECHART: the claim that "FACE_SCENARIOS ... typechecks against the Face and Theme unions" omits the event type. StateTransition<TState, TEvent> requires an event (@orkestrel/test dist/src/core/index.d.ts:703-712), and statechart.md:30-34 bars a union declared only to type a table. Required change: make the event the selected value (TEvent = Face for faces, Theme for themes), which Showcase's own select path consumes.

contract-first U3e: "Focus ring and visually-hidden-focusable captions state that keyboard focus paints them" inside an inert preview. inert removes focus and hit-testing, so neither the focus state nor the *-hover states (link-underline-opacity-75-hover, icon-link-hover) can be shown or reached there. Required change: the caption states that the state needs focus or hover and that the frame is inert until the engine lands.

contract-first U9: "validate shape with guards" by hand. The installed @orkestrel/browser core exports parseBrowserJourney and validateBrowserJourney (dist/src/core/index.d.ts:5660,6272). AGENTS.md requires reusing an installed primitive. Required change: U9 reuses that parser, after a probe confirms that its core entry loads in Chromium.

experience-first DESIGN: faces swap document.adoptedStyleSheets. The design is incompatible with every census proof, because readRules reads document.styleSheets only (index.js:2291-2303). Computed-style readings would still work, as integration.test.ts:411-426 shows through adoptSheet, but class-declaration proofs would not.

proposal.summary:
One single-file page, showcase/browser.html, built unchanged by appShowcase('browser') from app/browser. Two faces share the same markup and differ only in which shipped sheets the document holds as <style> elements:
- Bootstrap only: the built lifted sheet, imported with ?raw from dist/src/bootstrap/index.css.
- Bootstrap with Tailwind: a committed real Tailwind 4.3.3 compile of the published three-line recipe, inserted before the same Bootstrap sheet.

The compile is produced and pinned in Node tests (app/browser/recipe.json, RecipeRecord shape, conformance pin), so tailwindcss is never imported by app code.

Every one of the 2025 CLASS_NAMES.bootstrap names lands on the page through one of two routes: an ordered ownership table that drives generated utility matrices, or hand-authored section fragments. A per-section census, a two-way page census, and a face-invariance reading prove coverage and seamless co-use.

Interactive components are inert static skins with engine-set states written into the markup. An Engine states section records what each Bootstrap module's replacement will add.

The statechart covers the showcase's own Face and Theme entity. The browse MCP serves the built page for rendered checks and polish, and records three click-only journeys. Units avoid src/browser, tests/src/browser, src/styles, src/core, and every scaffold-owned file.
proposal.showcase:
Page shell, built only from Bootstrap classes: no extra stylesheet, no style attribute, and no fixed overlay.
- Skip link: a.visually-hidden-focusable to #content.
- Header: header.border-bottom.bg-body-tertiary > div.container-xxl.d-flex.flex-wrap.align-items-center.gap-3.py-3.
  - Brand: h1.h4.mb-0 "Veneer", with p.small.text-body-secondary.mb-0 "Bootstrap 5.3.8 on Veneer CSS".
  - Controls, using the runner-up's naming: div.btn-group.btn-group-sm[role=group][aria-label=Stylesheets] holds buttons "Bootstrap only" and "Bootstrap with Tailwind"; div.btn-group.btn-group-sm[aria-label="Color mode"] holds "Light" and "Dark". Each is a btn btn-outline-secondary with aria-pressed, and the pressed one also carries active.
  - Status: p[role=status][aria-label="Showcase state"], reading for example "Bootstrap with Tailwind, dark color mode".
- Body: div.container-xxl.py-5 > div.row.g-5.
  - Contents: on lg and wider, nav[aria-label=Contents].col-lg-3 holding div.sticky-lg-top.overflow-y-auto with a max-height utility; on narrow widths the same nav sits above main. The sidebar never overlaps an anchor target, so there is no scroll-margin problem and no extra CSS.
  - main#content[tabindex=-1].col-lg-9.
  - Group label in the contents: p.small.fw-semibold.text-uppercase.text-body-secondary. Links: a.link-body-emphasis.link-underline-opacity-0.link-underline-opacity-75-hover.
- Group heading: h2.h3.mt-5.mb-4.pb-2.border-bottom.
- Section: section.mb-5[aria-labelledby], with h3.h5.mb-1 and a one-sentence p.text-body-secondary.mb-4 lead.
- Specimen grid: div.row.row-cols-1.row-cols-xl-2.g-4, with col-12 for tables, navbar, carousel, and modal frames.
- Specimen: figure.card.h-100.mb-0[aria-labelledby=TITLE_ID] containing div.card-body.d-flex.flex-wrap.align-items-start.gap-3[inert] and figcaption.card-footer.bg-transparent.small, which holds span#TITLE_ID.d-block.fw-semibold and code.text-body-secondary listing the classes shown.
- Spacing: g-4 inside grids, mb-5 between sections, mt-5 before groups, gap-3 inside previews.
- Images: data-URI SVG only. Copy: fictional and descriptive.

Groups follow Bootstrap's documentation order: Layout, Content, Forms, Components, Helpers, Utilities, Engine states, and Bootstrap with Tailwind. Every section title is unique; the helper section is "Position helpers" and the utility section "Position utilities". Both faces render identical markup, and the Bootstrap with Tailwind group always renders, opening with a static alert-secondary note.

Enumeration:
- OWNERSHIP in constants.ts is an ordered {prefix, section, template?} table. A prefix matches a name equal to it or followed by a hyphen; the first match wins.
- Generated families render as one figure per family holding div.table-responsive > table.table.table-sm.align-middle. Columns are Base, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, and print where present, and each cell holds one specimen built by a closed set of template factories.
- Fragment sections come from app/browser/sections/*.html through import.meta.glob with ?raw.
- Static engine skins are written into the markup exactly as the contract-first showcase field lists them. Each such caption ends "Static state; the engine sets it." Focus and hover specimens say that the state needs focus or hover and that the frame is inert.

Build order: npm run build, then npm run build:showcase. Two consecutive builds must give an identical build-id.
proposal.engine:
Static inert skins (recommended and ruled by owner ruling 1):
- Engine-set classes are written into the markup, and every specimen preview carries inert. Tab order and role resolution then hold only the showcase's own controls, and the Refusal family has an exact voice.
- The Engine states section holds a table with the columns Module, What it toggles, Shown in, and What the engine adds. Rows cover Button, Carousel, Collapse, Dropdown, Modal, Offcanvas, Popover, Toast, Tooltip, Tab, Scrollspy, Alert, and the backdrop and swipe utilities.
- The only mechanical pin is the union of registry members that engine.json writes, equal in both directions to the union of the table's class cells. engine.json holds one witness site per name, so a per-file pin is refused.
- Names the engine writes that no rule reacts to (modal-open, hide) appear in the table lead.

Rejected:
- Live non-inert specimens: dead Tab stops, and ambiguous names under the resolver.
- A showcase toggle script: an engine in all but name, it would compete with the other session.

When the engine lands, frames drop inert family by family, and the table rows become component statecharts.
proposal.journeys:
File: tests/app/browser/integration.test.ts, rewritten.
- Variants in configs/app/vite.journey.config.ts become light-1280, dark-1280, light-390, and dark-390. The wrapper is birth-owned, and SKILL.md:91-92 mandates theme-plus-viewport names.
- applyTheme(VARIANT) in tests/setupBrowser.ts clicks Light or Dark through clickAccessible, then awaits pressed=true and settled paint.
- Families: Journey, Refusal, Matrix, Statechart, and Capture under the CAPTURE flag. The test asserts that the proven set equals the declared families.

Journeys:
- J1 Arrival: the h1 Veneer, the title "Veneer showcase", the status sentence, the pressed states, and the Contents region; then place('arrival').
- J2 Keyboard reach: Skip to content, Bootstrap only, Bootstrap with Tailwind, Light, Dark, then the first contents link. Enter on the skip link moves focus to main.
- J3 Browse every section: clickAccessibleWithin('Contents','link',TITLE), then the h3 is rendered with its top in the upper quarter of the viewport, then place(SECTION_ID).
- J4 Compare faces: through the buttons, read TAILWIND_READINGS under each face, then place('tailwindcss-face').
- J6 Vocabulary sweep: readPage() contains none of undefined, NaN, [object, or null.
- Dropped: J5, the unknown hash. It drives no application code.

Refusal: a fixed list of specimen control names (for example the button Primary and the textbox Email address) each throws the exact 'not visible and focus-reachable' voice. Measure in U7 whether Playwright's role engine reports inert elements as present or hidden; if hidden, assert the 'No interactive element' voice instead.

Matrix: one run loops all four variants (page.viewport, then applyTheme) under both faces and reads:
- face invariance plus the unexcluded control;
- TAILWIND_READINGS;
- the census;
- extractStyles equal to [], with the buildEscapes control;
- readContrast of at least 4.5 on the h1, a lead, a figcaption, and a contents link, with the buildContrast(4.5) control;
- readRootToken('--bs-body-bg') differing between the light and dark variants.
The run writes tmp/journey/VARIANT.txt.

Capture portfolio: arrival, every section id, and tailwindcss-face. Infinite animations are reported as not pixel-stable. Review goes to orkestrel-polish.
proposal.statechart:
Driven now: the Showcase entity in app/browser/Showcase.ts.
- Face = 'bootstrap' | 'tailwindcss' and Theme = 'light' | 'dark' live in app/browser/types.ts.
- The event of each table is the selected value (TEvent = Face, and TEvent = Theme), which Showcase's own select path consumes. No union exists only to type a table.
- FACE_SCENARIOS has 4 rows: bootstrap to tailwindcss, bootstrap staying bootstrap, tailwindcss to bootstrap, and tailwindcss staying tailwindcss. THEME_SCENARIOS has 4 matching rows. Each is named for the door it uses.
- Shared phases live in tests/setupBrowser.ts (statechart.md:37-38): arrange clicks only when needed; act calls clickAccessible('button', LABEL); assert reads the pressed pair and the status sentence, plus a resolved witness. That witness is padding-left 32px or 12px on the specimen "Tailwind padding on a Bootstrap button", or the body background color matched through matchesColor.
- build is buildShowcase, which dynamically imports '@app/browser'.
- Run executeScenarios on both tables, then createHarness for each. Assert the inventory before the tally and read harness.root through STATECHART_ATTRIBUTES. Call destroy in finally.

Section navigation is native hash links, proven by J3, and is not a statechart. Every component statechart (dropdown, collapse, modal, offcanvas, toast, tooltip, popover, carousel, tab) waits for the engine.
proposal.browse:
Prerequisite already met: @orkestrel/browser ^0.0.20 is declared (package.json:132) and installed, and the browse rules are present.

Setup:
- Register the server outside the repository in the user or local scope, running node node_modules/@orkestrel/browser/dist/bin/main.js with BROWSE_ROOT unset (quality.md:37).
- Serve with npm run build, then npm run build:showcase, then npx vite preview --config configs/app/vite.showcase.config.ts, and open /browser.html. Never use a file: URL.

Checks, each at 1280 and 390:
- B1 Arrival: page text, the accessibility tree, the pressed states, and the status.
- B2 Face switch: screenshots of the Bootstrap with Tailwind group under both faces.
- B3 Color mode: Dark, then a Components section and a Utilities matrix.
- B4 Contents: several links land with the heading visible, under no overlay, including the sticky-lg sidebar case.
- B5 Polish: spacing rhythm, caption legibility, matrix scroll at 390, and the engine frames. Findings go to orkestrel-polish.

Recordings: switch-face, switch-theme, and browse-card, using click steps only. Remove any navigate step through edit, because recorded.md:45 refuses it. Replay after every screen change.

Acceptance never comes from a browse session (recorded.md:64-66). Only U9's adapter, gated on D3, turns a recording into journey evidence.

risks: Every proof that reads dist fails when dist is unbuilt. Standalone runs of test:app:browser, test:journey, and showcase need npm run build first.

tests/setupBrowser.ts is a setup file for src:browser, src:vue, app:browser, setup:browser, and every CSS face project, and the engine session will add its own helpers and component scenarios there (statechart.md:37). Expect a merge collision; keep U6 additive, rebase before writing, and import no app code statically.
The face-invariance reading's cost is unmeasured: thousands of elements, six pseudo targets, two faces, and four variants. Budget from U7's measurement.
Scroll anchoring can move scrollY when the Tailwind group's height changes between faces. Boxes must be document-relative, read after scrollTo(0,0).
The readCascade regex reports md:flex and mt-[1rem] as undeclared. The census asserts that exact list, and the limit is reported upstream.
The committed recipe goes stale when TAILWIND_CLASSES, tailwindcss, or the built compatibility sheet changes. The pin reddens on drift, and regeneration needs the instrument again.
Hash navigation inside Vitest's browser iframe is unproven for J3. Report the finding if it fails.
Whether Playwright's role engine reports an inert element as present or hidden decides the exact refusal voice. Measure it in U7 before fixing the assertion.
Infinite animations make spinner and placeholder frames non-reproducible.
Page weight: tree-shaking of JSON named imports is unverified, so unexcluded and candidates might ship in the page.
guides/veneer.md and ROADMAP.md are shared with the styles campaign.

decisions.question: D1 Utility coverage display: every responsive variant rendered as a sample inside per-family matrices, or only base values sampled with variants listed as text
options: Full matrices inside table-responsive figures (census satisfied by rendering)
Sampled base row plus the remaining variants as code text inside the same figure (census still satisfied because the class sits on a text element, but the page shows less)
decisions.recommendation: Full matrices. Ruling 4 bars a raw dump, and a sampled matrix with labelled breakpoints is organized rather than dumped.

decisions.question: D2 Tailwind dark: under data-bs-theme
options: Keep the three-line recipe exact, use no dark: utility, and record the limit in the guide
Add a data-bs-theme custom dark variant to the showcase entry and pin it separately
decisions.recommendation: Keep the recipe exact. The showcase proves the published recipe.

decisions.question: D3 Browse recordings as evidence
options: Commit three reviewed recordings and add the U9 replay adapter
decisions.recommendation: Commit and adapt. It is the only route by which browse runs count toward a journey family.

decisions.question: D4 Plan of record
options: Add one Sequence line to ROADMAP.md for the showcase chunk
Record the showcase only in guides
decisions.recommendation: Add the line after rebasing on the styles campaign, because ROADMAP.md is the plan of record. It is a separate tree edit under ROADMAP.md:140.

decisions.question: D5 Committed Tailwind bytes in the page versus ROADMAP.md:15 ('import it only from tests and setup')
options: Accept: app imports a committed JSON record compiled and pinned in tests, never tailwindcss itself
Refuse: show the Tailwind face only inside journey tests, so the published page has a single face
decisions.recommendation: Accept. The page carries reproducible compiled output, not the package, and the conformance pin binds those bytes to the live compiler.
